Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J. 
An Application under Section 
21(1)(a) of the Uttar Pradesh Urban 
Buildings (Regulation of Letting, Rent 
and Eviction) Act, 1972 was filed by late 
Arjun Singh Rawat, the father of the 
petitioner no.1 and the husband of the 
petitioner no.2. The said Application was 
allowed. A Rent Appeal (No.1 of 2024) 
was filed by the respondent. The said 
Appeal has been allowed vide judgment 
dated 03.02.2025, passed by learned 
Additional District Judge, Kotdwar, 
District Pauri Garhwal. 
2. Heard Mr. Suryakant Maithani, 
learned counsel for the petitioners.
3. Notice is issued to the respondent. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
4. List on 22.05.2025.
